variation._note: Placeholder VRS Variation. Source: ClinGen Allele ID CA023436.

qualifiers.note: Semidominant. Loss of function is an established disease mechanism.

description: PVS-v17-LDLR rolled-up SVCv4 classification. Illustrative — scoring lives in CSpec. Source tab: 'v17: LDLR'. A splice-altering synonymous change (minigene + RT-PCR confirmed) under semidominant inheritance, with AD and biallelic probands.

hasEvidenceLines.description: Affected probands (illustrative). A biallelic proband also supports LOC_PHE.

hasEvidenceItems.description: Two AD probands meeting FH criteria (all FH genes tested); a third biallelic proband adds LOC_PHE.

value.phenotype: clinical diagnostic criteria for FH; FH panel negative for other genes
value.biallelic_proband: a third proband is homozygous/AR FH (LDLc 704 mg/dl) with p.Gln254Ter (P) in trans → LOC_PHE ~60% yield

hasEvidenceItems.description: Synonymous-appearing change that creates a new splice acceptor → frameshift; confirmed by minigene and RT-PCR.

value.prediction: natural exon-9 acceptor lost (1.0→0.57); new acceptor gained (0.00→1.00) → r.1189_1219del, p.Ser397ThrfsTer6
value.assays: minigene and RT-PCR confirm the acceptor gain
value.concordance: splicing data and PRD concordant; near-complete alternative transcript
